arxiv-1311-2210.title: On Interval Non-Edge-Colorable Eulerian Multigraphs
arxiv-1311-2210.creator: Petros A. Petrosyan
arxiv-1311-2210.description: Abstract An edge-coloring of a multigraph G G with colors 1 , … , t 1,\ldots,t is called an interval t t -coloring if all colors are used, and the colors of edges incident to any vertex of G G are distinct and form an interval of integers.

arxiv-2011-10943.title: Waveform Optimization with Multiple Performance Metrics for Broadband Joint Communication and Radar Sensing Thanks: Z. Ni, K. Yang are with the School of Information and Electronics, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing, 100081, China. Z. Ni is also with the Global Big Data Technologies Centre,
arxiv-2011-10943.creator: Zhitong Ni, , J. Andrew Zhang, , Kai Yang, , Xiaojing Huang, , and Theodoros A. Tsiftsis
arxiv-2011-10943.description: Abstract Joint communication and radar sensing (JCAS) integrates communication and radar/radio sensing into one system, sharing one transmitted signal. In this paper, we investigate JCAS waveform optimization underlying communication signals, where a base station detects radar targets and communicates with mobile users simultaneously. We first develop individual novel waveform optimization problems for communications and sensing, respectively.

arxiv-2112-09257.title: Derived Picard groups of symmetric representation-finite algebras of type D D Thanks: email: anya.nordskova@uhasselt.be Key words: Derived Picard groups, symmetric algebras, silting mutations, spherical twists.
arxiv-2112-09257.creator: Anya Nordskova
arxiv-2112-09257.description: Abstract . We explicitly describe the derived Picard groups of symmetric representation-finite algebras of type D D . In particular, we prove that these groups are generated by spherical twists along collections of 0 0 -spherical objects, the shift and autoequivalences which come from outer automorphisms of a particular representative of the derived equivalence class.

arxiv-2112-15201.title: Accepted in TWMS J. App. and Eng. Math. 2021 Soft Somewhat Continuous and Soft Somewhat Open Functions
arxiv-2112-15201.creator: Zanyar A. Ameen, Baravan A. Asaad, Tareq M. Al-shami
arxiv-2112-15201.description: Abstract . In this paper, we define a soft somewhat open set using the soft interior operator. We study main properties the class of soft somewhat open sets that is contained in the class soft somewhere dense sets. Then, we introduce the classes of soft somewhat continuous and soft somewhat open functions and soft somewhat homeomorphisms.

arxiv-2201-05438.title: Evaluating the root causes of fatigue and associated risk factors in the Brazilian regular aviation industry
arxiv-2201-05438.creator: Tulio E. Rodrigues 1,2,∗ , Frida M. Fischer 3 , Otaviano Helene 1 , Eduardo Antunes 4 , Eduardo Furlan 2 , Eduardo Morteo 2 , Alfredo Menquini 5 , João Lisboa 4 , Arnaldo Frank 5 , Alexandre Simões 6 , Karla Papazian 7 and André F. Helene 7
arxiv-2201-05438.description: Abstract This work evaluates the potential root causes of fatigue and its relationships with accident risks using a biomathematical model approach and a robust sample (N = 8476) of aircrew rosters from the Brazilian regular aviation, extracted from the Fadigômetro database.

arxiv-2205-01935.title: Thin current sheet formation: comparison between Earth’s magnetotail and coronal streamers Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2205-01935.creator: Artemyev A. V, Réville V, Ivan Zimovets, Nishimura Y, Velli M, Runov A, Angelopoulos V
arxiv-2205-01935.description: Abstract Magnetic field line reconnection is a universal plasma process responsible for the magnetic field topology change and magnetic field energy dissipation into charged particle heating and acceleration. In many systems, the conditions leading to the magnetic reconnection are determined by the pre-reconnection configuration of a thin layer with intense currents – otherwise known as the thin current sheet.

arxiv-2311-00004.title: Double parton scattering versus jet quenching
arxiv-2311-00004.creator: S. P. Baranov, A. V. Lipatov, M. A. Malyshev, A. M. Snigirev
arxiv-2311-00004.description: Abstract A novel observable, the double nuclear modification factor, is proposed to probe simultaneously the initial and final state effects in nucleus-nucleus collisions. An interesting competition between the combinatorial enhancement in the double parton scattering and the suppression due to parton energy loss can be observed in the production rate of two hard particles.

arxiv-2403-07083.title: HST Survey of the Orion Nebula Cluster in ACS/Visible and WFC3/IR Bands. IV. A Bayesian multi-wavelength study of stellar parameters in the ONC Facilities: HST (ACS, WFC3) Numpy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Price-Whelan et al. 2018 ) , Scipy ( Virtanen
arxiv-2403-07083.creator: Giovanni M. Strampelli, Massimo Robberto, Laurent Pueyo, Mario Gennaro, Carlo F. Manara, Elena Sabbi, Antonio Aparicio
arxiv-2403-07083.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Giovanni M. Strampelli, Massimo Robberto, Laurent Pueyo, Mario Gennaro, Carlo F. Manara, Elena Sabbi, Antonio Aparicio. We have performed a comprehensive study of the Orion Nebula Cluster (ONC) combining the photometric data obtained by the two HST Treasury programs that targeted this region. To consistently analyze the rich dataset obtained in a wide variety of filters, we adopted a Bayesian approach to fit the Spectral Energy Distribution of the sources, deriving mass, age, extinction, distance, and accretion for each source in the region.

arxiv-2404-06656.title: Reverse Divisors and Magic Numbers
arxiv-2404-06656.creator: Eudes Antonio Costa and Ronaldo Antonio Santos Federal University of Tocantins, Federal University of Goiás eudes@uft.edu.br, rasantos@ufg.br
arxiv-2404-06656.description: Abstract The study examines the relationship between Ball’s magic numbers and reverses divisors. These numbers are the source of beautiful and curious properties. Activities related to numbers can be a fun way to motivate mathematics students, while also enabling surprising analysis and connections.

arxiv-2405-19547.title: CLIPLoss and Norm-Based Data Selection Methods for Multimodal Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2405-19547.creator: Yiping Wang, Yifang Chen *, Wendan Yan, Alex Fang, Wenjing Zhou, Kevin Jamieson, Simon Shaolei Du
arxiv-2405-19547.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yiping Wang, Yifang Chen *, Wendan Yan, Alex Fang, Wenjing Zhou, Kevin Jamieson, Simon Shaolei Du. Data selection has emerged as a core issue for large-scale visual-language model pretraining (e.g., CLIP), particularly with noisy web-curated datasets.

arxiv-2505-12118.title: Do Code LLMs Do Static Analysis?
arxiv-2505-12118.creator: Chia-Yi Su, Collin McMillan
arxiv-2505-12118.description: Abstract This paper investigates code LLMs’ capability of static analysis during code intelligence tasks such as code summarization and generation. Code LLMs are now household names for their abilities to do some programming tasks that have heretofore required people. The process that people follow to do programming tasks has long been understood to require static analysis.

arxiv-2506-07667.title: Silencing Empowerment, Allowing Bigotry : Auditing the Moderation of Hate Speech on Twitch
arxiv-2506-07667.creator: Prarabdh Shukla, Wei Yin Chong, Yash Patel, Brennan Schaffner, Danish Pruthi, Arjun Bhagoji
arxiv-2506-07667.description: Abstract Warning : This paper contains content that may be offensive or upsetting. To meet the demands of content moderation, online platforms have resorted to automated systems. Newer forms of real-time engagement ( e.g. , users commenting on live streams) on platforms like Twitch exert additional pressures on the latency expected of such moderation systems.

arxiv-2511-19466.title: SG-OIF: A Stability-Guided Online Influence Framework for Reliable Vision Data
arxiv-2511-19466.creator: Penghao Rao, Runmin Jiang, Min Xu
arxiv-2511-19466.description: Abstract Approximating training-point influence on test predictions is critical for deploying deep-learning vision models, essential for locating noisy data. Though the influence function was proposed for attributing how infinitesimal up-weighting or removal of individual training examples affects model outputs, its implementation is still challenging in deep-learning vision models: inverse-curvature computations are expensive, and training non-stationarity invalidates static approximations.

arxiv-2512-00023.title: Trust or Bust: A Survey of Threats in Decentralized Wireless Networks PubID: pubid: Workshop on Security and Privacy of Next-Generation Networks (FutureG) 2025 24 February 2025, San Diego, CA, USA ISBN 979-8-9919276-7-3 https://dx.doi.org/10.14722/futureg.2025.23046 www.ndss-symposium.org
arxiv-2512-00023.creator: Hetvi Shastri 1 , Akanksha Atrey 2 , Andre Beck 2 , Nirupama Ravi 2
arxiv-2512-00023.description: Abstract The recent emergence of decentralized wireless networks empowers individual entities to own, operate, and offer subscriptionless connectivity services in exchange for monetary compensation. While traditional connectivity providers have built trust over decades through widespread adoption, established practices, and regulation, entities in a decentralized wireless network, lacking this foundation, may be incentivized to exploit the service for their own advantage.

pmc-10580293.title: A Critical Review of Data Science Applications in Resource Recovery and Carbon Capture from Organic Waste
pmc-10580293.creator: Mohammed
pmc-10580293.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Municipal and agricultural organic waste can be treated to recover energy, nutrients, and carbon through resource recovery and carbon capture (RRCC) technologies such as anaerobic digestion, struvite precipitation, and pyrolysis. Data science could benefit such technologies by improving their efficiency through data-driven process modeling along with reducing environmental and economic burdens via life cycle assessment (LCA) and techno-economic analysis (TEA), respectively. We critically reviewed 616 peer-reviewed articles on the use of data science in RRCC published during 2002–2022.

pmc-11316770.title: Nonlinear MPPT techniques to control hybrid power systems
pmc-11316770.creator: Naamane Debdouche, Habib Benbouhenni, Laid Zarour, Fateh Mehazzem, Brahim Deffaf, Ali Chebabhi, Thamer A H Alghamdi
pmc-11316770.description: In recent years, grid-connected multifunctional photovoltaic (PV) systems have proven to be highly efficient. This system integrates PV panels with a DC–DC boost converter (DC–DC–BC) and the electrical distribution grid (DEG). Linking the PV to the AC-DEG is accomplished through a three-level multifunctional voltage source inverter (MVSI).

pmc-11497422.title: Development of HepatIA: A computed tomography annotation platform and database for artificial intelligence training in hepatocellular carcinoma detection at a Brazilian tertiary teaching hospital
pmc-11497422.creator: Bruno Aragão Rocha, Lorena Carneiro Ferreira, Luis Gustavo Rocha Vianna, Ana Claudia Martins Ciconelle, João Martins Cortez Filho, Lucas Salume Lima Nogueira, Maurício Ricardo Moreira da Silva Filho, Claudia da Costa Leite, Cesar Higar Nomura, Giovanni Guido Cerri, Flair José Carrilho, Suzane Kioko
pmc-11497422.description: Highlights•The scarcity of publicly available computed tomography datasets with clinical details and four-phase segmentation masks hinders artificial intelligence research in hepatocellular carcinoma.•Developing an annotation platform in a teaching hospital necessitates integrating diverse technological tools and performing complex system integrations.•Successfully integrating an annotation platform and database for hepatocellular carcinoma can significantly enhance deep-learning research in this area.

pmc-11565635.title: Metastable Oxygen-Induced Light-Enhanced Doping in Mixed Sn–Pb Halide Perovskites
pmc-11565635.creator: Jasmeen Nespoli, Matthijs Mugge, Lara M. van der Poll, Snigdha Lal, Bahiya Ibrahim, Bart Boshuizen, Valentina M. Caselli, Arjan J. Houtepen, Lars J. Bannenberg, Tom J. Savenije
pmc-11565635.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Mixed Sn–Pb halide perovskites are promising absorber materials for solar cells due to the possibility of tuning the bandgap energy down to 1.2–1.3 eV. However, tin-containing perovskites are susceptible to oxidation affecting the optoelectronic properties. In this work, we investigated qualitatively and quantitatively metastable oxygen-induced doping in isolated ASnxPb1–xI3 (where A is methylammonium or a mixture of formamidinium and cesium) perovskite thin films by means of microwave conductivity, structural and optical characterization techniques.

pmc-11716086.title: Social connection profiles of older adults as both heritable and modifiable influences on brain health: data from the Older Australian Twins Study
pmc-11716086.creator: Suraj Samtani, Anne‐Nicole Casey, Anbupalam Thalamuthu, Ben CP Lam, Vibeke S Catts, Henry Brodaty, Perminder S Sachdev
pmc-11716086.description: BackgroundSocial connections are associated with brain health, but the extent to which social connections are heritable remains unclear. Using longitudinal twin data, we explored the heritable and environmental contributions to social connections. We hypothesised that social connections patterns would be moderately heritable and would be associated with better cognitive and mental health over time.

pmc-12618798.creator: Soufiane Azargui, Julia L Xia, Ian J McClain, Mark Dacey, Andrew B Wolf, Alan G Palestine, Amit K Reddy

pmc-12713284.description: BackgroundPhenylketonuria (PKU) is an inherited metabolic disorder where the body cannot break down phenylalanine (Phe), leading to its harmful accumulation if left untreated. Concerns have been raised about growth and risk of overweight in PKU patients, with conflicting research findings.

pmc-13500728.title: 非肌层浸润性膀胱癌膀胱灌注治疗研究进展
pmc-13500728.creator: 锦强 李, 阳 薛, 昭群 郭, 沙舟 叶, 琪 马, 晓龙 贾
pmc-13500728.description: 膀胱癌(bladder cancer，BCa)是泌尿系统常见的恶性肿瘤，非肌层浸润性膀胱癌(non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer，NMIBC)约占初诊BCa的75%，目前其主要的治疗手段是经尿道膀胱肿瘤电切术(transurethral resection of bladder tumor，TURBT)，但术后复发率较高，因此术后辅助药物治疗成为重要的治疗手段。近年来，NMIBC的药物治疗策略在免疫治疗、靶向治疗及新型给药系统等方面均取得了显著进展。免疫检查点抑制剂(immune checkpoint inhibitors，ICIs)已被证实对卡介苗无应答高危患者具有明确疗效。抗体药物偶联物(antibody-drug conjugate，ADC)如RC-48在特定人群中展现出良好的抗肿瘤活性。靶向治疗方面，厄达替尼在伴FGFR突变或融合的BCa患者中取得突破性进展。新型给药系统如丝裂霉素水凝胶给药系统UGN-102已被美国食品药品监督管理局批准上市。此外，基因治疗如Nadofaragene firadenovec已进入临床应用阶段，病毒疗法等新型治疗模式已进入临床试验阶段。深入了解NMIBC膀胱灌注治疗的最新进展，有助于为NMIBC的临床决策提供循证依据，为未来联合治疗和个体化治疗提供参考。 膀胱癌(bladder cancer，BCa)是全球第9大常见的恶性肿瘤，非肌层浸润性膀胱癌(non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer，NMIBC)是局限于膀胱黏膜和黏膜下层的癌症，约占BCa新发病例的75%[1]，主要包括原位癌(carcinoma in situ，CIS)、Ta(乳头状无浸润)和 T1(肿瘤侵犯上皮下结缔组织)期肿瘤。目前，NMIBC最主要的治疗方式是经尿道膀胱肿瘤电切术(transurethral resection of bladder tumor，TURBT)。这种手术方式能够切除视野内可见的肿瘤组织，但是术后的肿瘤复发率较高。临床研究[2]表明，经TURBT治疗后5年复发率为31%~78%，且少部分复发患者会出现病理级别增高。这不仅增加患者的痛苦和经济负担，也严重影响患者的生存率和生活质量。因此，NMIBC术后的药物辅助治疗至关重要。目前NMIBC的药物治疗主要为术后辅以膀胱灌注治疗，主要使用化疗药物或卡介苗(Bacillus Calmette-guérin，BCG)。据相关研究[3]统计，TURBT术后进行膀胱内辅助化疗的患者，其5年复发率比单纯进行TURBT的患者降低了35%。此外，一项多中心、随机对照研究[4]结果表明，与接受表柔比星灌注化疗比较，中高风险NMIBC患者接受BCG灌注治疗可以显著降低2年复发率(14.2% vs 27.7%)。尽管NMIBC患者在术后接受了规范的辅助膀胱灌注治疗，但仍有超过50%的患者在1~2年复发，其中30%~40%的患者对BCG治疗无反应。BCG的短缺也导致了大量患者失去治疗机会。近年来针对NMIBC的膀胱灌注药物治疗和给药系统的研究取得了一定的进展，本文重点讨论NMIBC膀胱内灌注药物和给药系统的研究进展。 膀胱内化学消融与装置辅助治疗 UGN-102 UGN-102是一种基于丝裂霉素的创新性膀胱内给药系统，采用UroGen公司独有的水凝胶缓释技术，可实现药物在膀胱内的持续释放，从而增强其抗肿瘤效应。 近几年有多项临床研究探讨了UGN-102治疗NMIBC患者的疗效，如一项Ⅱb期前瞻性研究OPTIMA II[5]评估了UGN-102治疗低级别中危NMIBC的疗效和安全性。该试验纳入了63名接受每周1次，共6周UGN-102治疗的患者，结果表明，治疗开始后3个月，65%的患者达到完全缓解(complete response，CR)，其中95%、73%和61%在6、9和12个月时保持无病状态。随后的一项纳入282名低级别中危NMIBC患者的Ⅲ期ATLAS研究[6]进一步表明，UGN-102组在3个月时的CR率(65%)与TURBT组(64%)相当，但其无疾病进展率在15个月时显著更优(72% vs 50%)，且药物反应持续性也更长。一项国际多中心单臂Ⅲ期临床研究ENVISION[7]纳入240例复发的低级别中危NMIBC患者，经UGN-102治疗3个月后，CR率达80%，且CR患者1年无病生存率达82%。OPTIMAII与ENVISION 2项研究的3个月CR率存在差异，可能是因为ENVISION入组患者病灶大于3 cm的比例远小于OPTIMA II(8.1% vs 27.9%)，且OPTIMA II样本量较小，单臂设计也使结果更易受基线差异影响。 上述结果显示，UGN-102更适合低级别中危复发性NMIBC患者的保膀胱、减少手术次数的策略，而非高危或BCG无反应患者的替代治疗。基于这些临床数据，2025年6月12日UGN-102被美国食品药品监督管理局(Food and Drug Administration，FDA)批准用于治疗复发性低级别中危NMIBC患者。 TAR-200 TAR-200是一种吉西他滨膀胱内缓释给药系统，采用硅胶双腔导管设计，可在置入膀胱后以受控方式持续释放吉西他滨，治疗结束后可经膀胱镜取出。与传统的灌注给药相比，TAR-200能够实现局部长期稳定释药，并通过低剂量递送策略降低膀胱及全身毒性。 目前有多项关于TAR-200治疗NMIBC的临床研究正在进行，如一项Ⅰb期临床研究[8]展示了TAR-200治疗中等风险NMIBC患者的疗效和安全性，结果显示，入组的12名患者经过2次TAR-200治疗后的CR率为42%(5/12)，且未发生3级及以上的治疗相关不良事件(treatment-related adverse event，TRAE)。该结果为正在进行的多项Ⅱ、Ⅲ期临床研究奠定了良好的基础。SunRISe-1研究[9]是一项多中心、随机、开放标签的Ⅱb期研究，入组人群为BCG无反应的CIS或仅乳头状病变的NMIBC患者。旨在比较TAR-200单药(n=85)、TAR-200联合西利单抗[程序性死亡受体-1(programmed death-1，PD-1)抑制剂](n=53)及西利单抗单药(n=28)在BCG无反应的高危非肌层浸润性膀胱癌(high-risk NMIBC，HR-NMIBC)患者中的疗效。中期结果显示，TAR-200单药治疗组3、6及12个月的CR率分别为82.8%、75.7%和61.9%，中位反应持续时间(duration of response，DOR)为25.8个月，TAR-200联合西利单抗组12个月持续缓解率为76.3%，而西利单抗单药组12个月持续缓解率约为38.

pmc-13680707.title: Aging brain lesions of a 60-year-old Bornean orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus)
pmc-13680707.creator: Yutaro NAKAYAMA, James K CHAMBERS, Kaori OTA, Ayumi YAMAGUCHI, Kosuke TODA, Saori SATO, Akane KATO, Yuka KAMAKURA, Kazuyuki UCHIDA
pmc-13680707.description: A female Bornean orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus) raised in a zoo died at 60 years of age. The animal showed no clinical signs besides decreased gait speed. Pathological examination revealed small hemorrhagic foci in the cerebral cortex and liver fibrosis with fatty degeneration of the hepatocytes. To evaluate aging lesions, the brain was examined histologically and immunohistochemically.
